home.deleteDescription: The conversation and this study's output files will be deleted. Personas in the library are kept.
home.noStudies: No studies yet. Ask a business question or start from a template above.

home.templatesHint: Pick one to start; you can edit it
home.title: Ask them.

hypothesis.aiOnly: AI interviews only, no external check
hypothesis.empty: Once the plan is confirmed, the hypotheses and their criteria appear here.
hypothesis.emptyLegacy: This study was created before hypotheses were tracked.
hypothesis.ruleHint: AI-only evidence can at most be “partly supported”

library.createChatHint: Describe the audience, or upload interviews, surveys or customer data. The AI drafts personas for you to confirm
library.createManualHint: Model a customer you know, field by field
library.deleteDescription: The persona file is removed from the library. Finished studies and transcripts are not affected, but new studies can no longer use it.
library.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Try again later
library.empty: Create personas with AI, fill one in manually, or run a study and let the AI build them.
library.subtitle: Personas built during studies and the ones you create live here and can be reused in new studies
library.title: Persona library

persona.contradictionsHint: People rarely act exactly as they say; keeping contradictions makes answers more realistic.
persona.editedNotice: You edited this persona on {{date}}. Edited fields are marked “By you”.
persona.noEvidence: No sources were recorded for this persona; it is inferred. Use its answers with care.
persona.stanceHint: Stance on each hypothesis: green agrees, amber partly, red disagrees, grey not mentioned

tierHint.evidenceBased: Key traits are backed by traceable sources, so confidence is higher.
tierHint.generated: Inferred from common knowledge and the study goal. Good for exploring; treat conclusions with care.
tierHint.imported: Built from materials you uploaded, so it is closest to your real customers.
tierHint.manual: Filled in by you and not checked against materials or public sources. Good for quickly modeling a customer you know.

phaseHint.clarify: The AI asks a few key questions to pin down the decision the study supports
phaseHint.deskResearch: Searches and reads public sources into sourced market insights
phaseHint.interview: Builds or reuses AI personas and runs interviews and focus groups in parallel
phaseHint.plan: Proposes a study plan that is locked once you confirm it
phaseHint.report: Combines interviews and sources into a report where every claim is sourced
phaseHint.validation: Creates a questionnaire to retest key findings with real people

quality.highInferred: Much of this interview is inferred, so it carries less weight in the report.

report.empty: The report appears here when the study is done.

scenario.contentPrompt: Research what content [target audience] like and where they get information, then suggest a content strategy.
scenario.productPrompt: We plan to build [product direction]. Research the target users' needs and propose a few product concepts worth validating.
